notes.title: Playtest Hotfix 1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added: Option "Automatically hide Blade Abilities list" – disable to keep the list open after adding an ability
[*] Fixed: Hotkey A toggling Blade Abilities list, even if not in blade mode
[*] Fixed: German language option caption changed to "Deutsch"
[*] Fixed: A few other minor fixes, thank you for your reports!
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update: BLADE MATERIALS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178535/bba1d6991703f097560f270e1a3702fe05dc837f.png[/img]

From now on, [b]all materials[/b] are available for use on the blade 🥳

To have you not go insane with the grown number of blade materials, we've slightly improved the way in which you select the blade material by splitting it into forward and back buttons. At some point in the future, we are going make blade material assignment work the same way as part material assignment 💅

notes.title: Playtest Update: HEADS OF SIHINORA
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178535/948d87b43528a38cf0057a8f57cb2551e076d86d.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] NEW SWORD PARTS: “Heads of Sihinora” set 🐍
[*] Story Mode: Overhauled requirements UI for more clarity
[*] Story Mode: Made the baseline point detection much more lenient
[*] Story Mode: Add limits to prevent zero-thickness/zero-width blades
[*] Fix: Tang length with parts using sink
[*] Fix: Tang end-cap glitch
[*] Fix: Edge case computation errors (divide by 0) in rating computation
[*] Fix: Hammering instructions not showing up in Story Mode if Sliders selected in Creative Mode
[*] Fix: Crash when using ctrl-z on just-created ability in Creative Mode
[*] Fix: Billet cost being refunded after continuing a commission from loaded savegame in Story Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update: MATERIALS & MARBLE
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Overhauled all materials, so you can now polish wood, leather, cord wrap... everything! 🔥
[*] Added material Wire Wrap (Gold)! 🪙
[*] Added two new marble environments! 🔪
[/list]
